facts.text: Under the Lion Pride Tuition Discount, students from every state touching Missouri—Arkansas, Kansas, Oklahoma, Illinois, Iowa, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Nebraska—as well as all counties in Texas, California, Nevada, Arizona, and Florida, pay the same tuition rate as in-state students.

sources.title: Admissions Tuition and Rates - Missouri Southern State University
sources.quote: Missouri Southern's Lion Pride Tuition Discount includes every state touching Missouri: Arkansas, Kansas, Oklahoma, Illinois, Iowa, Tennessee, Kentucky, Nebraska; and all counties in Texas, California, Nevada, Arizona, and Florida.

sources.title: MSSU - Estimated Cost of Attendance
sources.quote: Students receiving the Lion Pride Tuition Discount are billed for the full out-of-state tuition price, however, after the Lion Pride Discount is applied, they pay the same amount as an in-state student.

facts.text: In May of 1995, legislation was signed authorizing Missouri Southern State College to establish international education as distinctive to its mission, which continues as part of the university's statewide mission today.

sources.title: MSSU History - Missouri Southern State University
sources.quote: In May of 1995 Governor Mel Carnahan signed legislation that authorized Missouri Southern State College to establish international education as distinctive to its mission. International education is still a part of Missouri Southern's statewide mission today.
